integrity.proof_scope: All integers M at least 3 over the complex numbers; the universal argument is algebraic, with finite SymPy checks only corroborative.

limitations: The geometric classification is of the reduced singular locus; transverse ordinary quadratic forms are established on dense open subsets of the six components, not at their mutual intersections or as a classification of the complete Jacobian scheme. Priority is judged against the inspected accessible literature, not independently certified.
title: Six equidimensional singular components in the three-vector off-diagonal Gram zero fiber
